intro:
Hi [NAME], thanks for reaching out! I'm EuroRWA — I build on-chain data pipelines, dashboards, AI agents and Telegram bots for tokenized RWA / DeFi projects.

Quick overview:
• Dashboards / frontends — $80-150
• Telegram / Discord bots — $80-150
• Data / API / scraping — $40-100
• Smart contracts / onchain — $150-300
• Small scripts / tools — $30-60

Describe your task in 1-2 sentences and I'll quote a price right away.
no_call: One note on communication: I prefer written, async messages (Telegram or email) — it keeps everything documented and lets me respond fast. I'm available in chat throughout the day. If a quick call is strictly needed I can join, but please keep follow-ups written.
lead_draft:
Hi [NAME]! Thanks for reaching out — I'm definitely interested.

I build on-chain data pipelines, dashboards, AI agents and Telegram bots for RWA/DeFi projects. My main work: EuroRWA — a tokenized money-market dashboard where every snapshot is hashed + signed on-chain so anyone can verify it. I can start immediately.

One note: I prefer written, async communication (Telegram is perfect). If a call is required I'll join, but I'll follow up in writing. What's the role / timeline?

recruiter.1_interest:
Hi [NAME], thanks for reaching out about the [ROLE] at [COMPANY]. I'm interested — on-chain RWA data has been my main focus this year and the role matches that exactly.

What I'd bring: I built EuroRWA, a tokenized money-market dashboard that scrapes fund data, attests every snapshot on-chain (Sepolia), and posts verified updates through an AI agent pipeline + Telegram bots.

I can start immediately.
recruiter.2_experience:
Relevant experience: since Jan 2025 I've built the EuroRWA platform end-to-end — daily scrapers for 15+ EU/US tokenized MMFs (rwa.xyz, issuer sites), an on-chain attestation system that hashes each snapshot and signs it to the chain so anyone can verify, and an AI agent that analyzes the data and posts updates.

Also experienced with Telegram bots (client intake, quotes, payments) and light smart-contract work on Sepolia.
recruiter.3_techstack:
Honest view of my stack: strong in TypeScript, Node/Bun, React, Python, SQLite, scraping, REST/GraphQL APIs. I've built with Viem + Solidity on Sepolia, and used Effect/Drizzle for typed pipelines.

I haven't worked with FIX protocol or C++ trading systems, and I haven't used QuantConnect/backtesting platforms — my quant work is scripted in Python/TypeScript. If the role is heavy on those specific tools I'd need ramp-up time.
recruiter.4_ml: On the ML side I've used LightGBM for tabular prediction (feature engineering, training, evaluation). For trading models I'd combine on-chain signals (flows, yield spreads, holder growth) with market data as features — and keep the pipeline simple and auditable. I'm pragmatic about models: start with strong, explainable baselines, only add complexity where it earns its keep.
recruiter.5_direction: I trade both directions. I don't have an ideological bias to long-only — with on-chain data you can find flow-driven momentum in both directions. That said, most of my own work has been long-side on RWA/stablecoin yields, where the data edge is clearest.
recruiter.6_trading: Personal trading: I've traded crypto spot and futures (perpetuals), mostly on technicals plus on-chain flow signals. I keep positions small and methodical — I built my own tracking scripts rather than relying on exchange dashboards. No multi-year professional trading track record, being honest.
recruiter.7_location: I'm based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. I work remote-first and my hours overlap well with US/Europe afternoons. I can keep working from Vietnam — no relocation needed and no visa sponsorship required (Vietnamese citizen).
recruiter.8_language: English: conversational. I work in English every day — code, docs, and written communication are fine and comfortable. My written English is better than my spoken; I prefer async, written communication. I can handle technical screening in writing, and if a call is required I'll join, but I'll always follow up in writing.
recruiter.9_availability: I can start immediately — I'll commit to the role as my top priority from day one.
recruiter.10_comp: Compensation: I'm open and flexible. Given I can start immediately and work from Vietnam, I'm primarily optimizing for the right technical challenge and growth. Happy to discuss a number that fits [COMPANY]'s budget for the [ROLE].
